security.title: Security Architecture
security.subtitle: Defense in depth, zero trust, encryption first — our security architecture protects your data at every layer.
security.zeroTrustDesc: Autional adopts a Zero Trust security model with the core principle of 'never trust, always verify.' All access requests, regardless of internal or external origin, must undergo identity verification, device trust assessment, and dynamic authorization.
security.encryptionDesc: From data transmission to static storage, the entire chain employs industry-leading encryption standards to ensure data is protected in any state.
security.infrastructureDesc: Multi-region cloud infrastructure deployment combined with defense-in-depth strategies to build a highly available, attack-resistant operating environment.
security.observabilityDesc: Full traceability of all operations with tamper-proof audit logs, providing complete evidence chains for security incident investigations and compliance audits.
security.penTestDesc: Quarterly black-box/gray-box penetration tests by internationally renowned security firms, covering web applications, APIs, mobile clients, and cloud infrastructure.
security.bugBountyDesc: Accepting vulnerability reports from global security researchers through public disclosure platforms, with critical vulnerabilities fixed within 48 hours on average.
security.codeAuditDesc: All code must pass three gates before merging: SAST (static analysis), SCA (dependency scanning), and secret leak detection.
security.soc247Desc: Dedicated Security Operations Center continuously monitors global threat intelligence, with MTTD < 15 minutes and MTTR < 1 hour.
security.vulnerabilityDisclosureDesc: We welcome responsible disclosure. Please contact us at , usually acknowledged within 24 hours.

events.title: Third-Party Dependency Security Update
events.description: Security team detected a known CVE (CVSS 4.2) in an indirect dependency. The dependency exposed no attack surface at runtime, but out of caution we completed the patch upgrade within 2 hours.
events.impact: No customer data affected, no service interruption.
events.resolution: Upgraded dependency to secure version and strengthened SCA scanning rules to prevent similar issues.

events.title: DDoS Attack Mitigation
events.description: Autional gateway suffered a reflected DDoS attack peaking at ~120 Gbps. The automated traffic scrubbing system triggered within 30 seconds, completely filtering the attack traffic.
events.impact: Some regional users observed minor latency (< 200ms) in the first minute of the attack. No service unavailability.
events.resolution: Cloud scrubbing service mitigated automatically. Post-incident threshold adjustments and edge node capacity increase.

events.title: Certificate Rotation Exception
events.description: Automated certificate rotation task failed on one edge node, causing brief TLS handshake alerts on that node.
events.impact: Approximately 0.03% of requests experienced TLS handshake retries within 3 minutes.
events.resolution: Manually triggered rotation and fixed race condition in automation task. Added certificate expiry monitoring alerts.

events.title: False Positive Alert Investigation
events.description: SIEM system produced a large number of false positive alerts about 'abnormal logins' due to overly broad rule configuration.
events.impact: No actual security incident. SOC team spent approximately 2 hours performing rule tuning.
events.resolution: Tightened detection rules, added whitelist mechanism, optimized baseline learning period.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.contactDpoDesc: If you have any questions about our privacy policy or wish to exercise your data subject rights, please contact our DPO:
privacy.dpoAddressText: Autional Data Protection Office, Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

collection: Account information: username, email, phone number, password hash (irreversibly encrypted storage).
Usage data: login time, IP address, device fingerprint, operation logs (for security auditing and anomaly detection).
Tenant configuration: company name, department structure, application configuration, branding customization information.
Payment information: billing address, transaction records (card numbers are processed by PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways; Autional does not store full card numbers).
usage: Providing identity authentication and access management services.
Ensuring account security and fraud detection.
Fulfilling legal and compliance obligations (e.g., tax, audit).
With your explicit consent, sending product updates and security notifications.
sharing: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

Data is shared only under the following circumstances: (a) with your explicit authorization; (b) with partners necessary for service delivery (e.g., cloud infrastructure providers); (c) as required by law or regulation.
All third-party subprocessors are bound by Data Processing Agreements (DPA) and meet equivalent security standards.
crossBorder: By default, data is stored in the geographic region of your choice (see Data Residency page).
When cross-border data transfer is required, we use EU Commission-approved Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) or other legal mechanisms.
You can always learn about your data storage location and cross-border transfer status.
retention: Account data is retained until you delete your account or 90 days after contract termination (except where required by law).
Audit logs are retained for 1-7 years depending on regional regulations, as required for compliance.
You have the right to request deletion of your personal data at any time (GDPR 'right to be forgotten' / China Personal Information Protection Law deletion right).
rights: Right of access: understand what data we hold about you.
Right of rectification: update inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Right of erasure: request deletion of your personal data.
Right of portability: obtain a copy of your personal data in a structured, commonly used format.
Right to object: object to processing based on legitimate interests.
Right to withdraw consent: withdraw previously given consent at any time.
cookies: We use essential cookies to maintain service operations (e.g., session persistence, security tokens).
Analytics cookies are used solely to improve product experience and are not used for cross-site tracking.
You can manage cookie preferences through browser settings, but disabling essential cookies may affect service usage.

rules.title: Rules of Engagement
rules.desc: To protect user data and service stability, please follow these testing rules.
items: No automated scanning that generates excessive traffic
No accessing or modifying other users' data
No lateral movement or persistence using vulnerabilities
Please use only your own test accounts
Stop immediately upon discovering a vulnerability and report it
Provide reproducible PoC and impact assessment
Do not publicly disclose before the vulnerability is fixed

vdp.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
vdp.subtitle: We value the contributions of the security research community and welcome responsible disclosure of security vulnerabilities. This policy defines the scope, rules, and process.
vdp.scope.title: Scope
vdp.scope.desc: The following systems and assets are in scope. Testing outside this scope requires prior written authorization.
vdp.scope.web.label: Web & API
vdp.scope.mobile.label: Mobile Apps
vdp.scope.infra.label: Infrastructure
vdp.scope.infra.items: Docker container orchestration and network policies
vdp.rules.title: Rules of Engagement
vdp.rules.desc: To protect user data and service stability, please follow these testing rules.
vdp.rules.items: No automated scanning that generates excessive traffic
No accessing or modifying other users' data
No lateral movement or persistence using vulnerabilities
Please use only your own test accounts
Stop immediately upon discovering a vulnerability and report it
Provide reproducible PoC and impact assessment
Do not publicly disclose before the vulnerability is fixed
vdp.report.title: How to Report
vdp.report.desc: Please report security vulnerabilities through the following channels. We recommend using PGP encryption.
vdp.report.emailDesc: Reports should include: vulnerability description, affected endpoints/components, reproduction steps, impact assessment, and remediation suggestions.

vdp.sla.desc: We commit to the following service level agreements for vulnerability report handling.

vdp.sla.rows.label: Initial Acknowledgment
vdp.sla.rows.desc: Confirm receipt and assign tracking ID

vdp.sla.rows.label: Triage
vdp.sla.rows.desc: Assess severity and determine fix priority

vdp.safeHarbor.title: Safe Harbor
vdp.safeHarbor.commitment: Autional commits to not pursuing legal action against good-faith security research that faithfully follows this policy. We recognize and appreciate the efforts of the security community in protecting our mutual users.
vdp.safeHarbor.conditions: Safe harbor protection is contingent on: obtaining explicit authorization before exceeding the scope defined in this policy; not causing actual damage or data breach; destroying all Autional data obtained during testing after reporting.
vdp.hallOfFame.title: Hall of Fame
vdp.hallOfFame.desc: We will soon launch a Security Researcher Hall of Fame to recognize outstanding contributions from the security research community. Thank you to every researcher working to protect user security!
